jobs.title: Group Product Manager - Risk and Compliance
jobs.description:
At Morgan & Morgan, the work we do matters. For millions of Americans, we’re their last line of defense against insurance companies, large corporations or defective goods. From attorneys in all 50 states, to client support staff, creative marketing to operations teams, every member of our firm has a key role to play in the winning fight for consumer rights. Our over 6,000 employees are all united by one mission: For the People.
Summary:

At Morgan & Morgan, we’re constantly challenging people’s idea of what an injury law firm can be, and technology plays a major role in how we serve our clients. We are in a unique position as the largest injury firm in the world to continuously deliver a delightful and consistent experience for people facing the greatest challenge of their lives.  
We’re looking for a Group Product Manager to join our Risk and Compliance product team. In this senior leadership role, you will own the vision, strategy, and execution for one of our core product areas – managing a team of Product Managers and driving deep collaboration across Engineering, Design, Data, and executive leadership. You’ll be accountable for defining what we build, why we build it, and how we measure success. This is an in-office position 4 days a week in our Brooklyn office. Relocation assistance is not available.  
Responsibilities:

As a Group Product Manager, you will own the health and direction of a major product area that supports a multi-billion dollar business unit. This is not a pure-play management role – you will remain deeply engaged in product discovery, definition, and delivery alongside your team. We value operators and builders over theorists: success here is measured by what ships, what improves, and what outcomes are achieved. Responsibilities include, but are not limited to:  
Product Vision & Strategy:

Own the product vision and strategy for our Risk and Compliance team. Define a compelling, multi-quarter roadmap, translate firm-wide priorities into a clear product thesis, and continuously refine direction based on data, user research, and operational realities.  

Hands-On Product Ownership:

 Stay actively engaged in the work – writing requirements, shaping feature specs, reviewing designs, and participating in discovery for high-priority initiatives. Lead by example and maintain deep product context across your area.  

AI Integration & Workflow Innovation:

 Identify and drive opportunities to inject AI and automation into existing client and attorney-facing workflows. Move beyond net-new AI features to systematically evaluate where intelligence can accelerate, simplify, or transform how work gets done across the firm.  

Team Leadership & Development:

 Lead, mentor, and grow a team of Product Managers. Set clear expectations, build a high-performance culture, balance workloads, and develop each PM’s skills and career trajectory.  

Cross-Functional Execution:

 Drive tight collaboration with Engineering, Design, Data, and Operations teams to deliver products on time and with high quality. Remove blockers, manage dependencies, and maintain delivery momentum across parallel workstreams.  

Executive Stakeholder Management:

 Build trust with senior leaders and key business stakeholders. Communicate product strategy, tradeoffs, priorities, and progress with clarity and confidence. Represent the product perspective in executive forums.  

Outcomes & KPI Ownership:

 Define what success looks like for your product area. Establish leading and lagging metrics, monitor adoption and performance post-launch, and drive rapid iteration informed by results.  

Go-to-Market & Adoption:

 Partner with Operations, Legal, and L&D to develop and execute adoption plans for new capabilities. Ensure rollouts are smooth, well-communicated, and sticky.  

Capacity & Portfolio Management:

 Maintain a healthy team backlog, balance competing priorities across the product portfolio, surface resource constraints early, and make prioritization tradeoffs transparent to leadership.  

Qualifications:

6+ years of professional experience within Risk and Compliance environments.
8+ years of experience in product management, product operations, consulting, business integration, or a related leadership role; including PE-backed operational environments.
Demonstrated success managing and developing teams of Product Managers or cross-functional contributors, with a track record of building high-performing teams.
Proven ability to identify and inject AI tools and automation into existing business workflows – not just greenfield AI products, but pragmatic integration that drives measurable efficiency and outcome improvements.
Active use of AI as a force multiplier in your own work; leveraging AI tools to accelerate research, analysis, writing, prioritization, and decision-making.
Strong data fluency and able to define KPIs, interpret product analytics, run or commission user research, and drive evidence-based prioritization.
Exceptional communication and stakeholder influence skills – comfortable presenting strategy and navigating competing priorities with senior leadership.
Proven track record of delivering complex, multi-workstream product initiatives from concept through launch and iteration.
Executional track record – you are known for getting things done, not just framing problems. Candidates who thrive here have a bias toward shipping, iterating, and driving operational improvement over process documentation or theoretical frameworks. 

Nice to Have:

Exposure to the legal industry and technology in law firms.  

Experience in Agile, Scrum, or Kanban delivery environments.  

Familiarity with enterprise legal tech platforms or case management workflows.  

Experience in a high-growth or PE-backed organization scaling consumer or B2B products.  

Track record of building or launching AI-native product capabilities.  

Salary Range:
$220,000–$250,000 USD + Bonus Potential

Morgan & Morgan is a leading personal injury law firm dedicated to protecting the people, not the powerful. This success starts with our staff.  For full-time employees, we offer an excellent benefits package including medical and dental insurance, 401(k) plan,  paid time off and paid holidays.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager - Investment Platform
jobs.description:
Role Summary

Global X operates a large and growing ETF platform across multiple markets. Our investment desk runs on proprietary technology built in-house for portfolio management, trading, and the operational workflow around it. We are hiring the founding product owner for that platform — in effect, the operating system for our trading and portfolio management desks — measured on adoption and business impact rather than delivery milestones.

The mandate is to make expert work easier and give the business more capacity: guided workflows where a process is multi-step, expert surfaces where they genuinely help. Deciding where that line falls is the substance of the role — in a regulated domain where accuracy is a compliance matter and your users will tell you immediately when something is wrong.

This is a product role for someone who builds. A clickable prototype is the preferred form of a specification. We are an AI-forward team, and product is expected to move at the same speed as engineering. You will help shape the product function as the platform and the team grow around it.

Key Responsibilities

Product Strategy & Workflow Definition

Define and execute the product strategy and roadmap, sequenced by business value and defensible to stakeholders who each want their own priority first.
Decide what becomes a guided flow and what stays an expert surface, and own the defaults — grounded in observed usage, not the loudest request.
Design workflows that hold up across markets, calendars, and regions rather than encoding the practice of a single desk.
Track ETF market structure developments and regulatory change, and translate their implications into product direction.

Prototyping & Hands-On Delivery

Prototype your own proposals with AI product tooling and put something clickable in front of a portfolio manager rather than describing it.
Do your own analysis. Query the data, quantify the case, and bring evidence rather than anecdote.
Write requirements and acceptance criteria an engineer can build from directly, and run delivery against a visible, prioritized backlog.

Commercial Impact & Platform Growth

Own the business case. Quantify where the platform creates capacity, reduces risk, and shortens time to launch, and make that case to leadership.
Drive expansion beyond the initial desk: identify the next adopters across teams and affiliated businesses, and build the plan to bring them on.

Adoption, Risk & Governance

Own adoption: readiness criteria, sequencing, champions, training, and the communications that carry each stage of rollout.
Define how AI-assisted and agent-initiated actions behave in the product — what a user sees, what requires approval, and what is recorded.
Partner with compliance and risk so controls, approval thresholds, and audit evidence are designed in, and assess risk with regard for the firm’s reputation and obligations.

You Are

Energized by building alongside engineers, and happiest when something is in front of a user.
A self-starter who does well with ambiguity and a wide remit.
Curious beyond your comfort zone, and quick to learn a domain in depth.
Willing to challenge convention, and disciplined about bringing evidence when you do.
Precise. You would rather be right than fast, and you know when the two are not in conflict.

Qualifications

7+ years in product management, product ownership, or senior business analysis for investment or trading technology, buy side or platform vendor.
Hands-on output: prototypes, demos, internal tools, or analyses you built yourself and would enjoy showing us, and fluent daily use of AI tooling to produce them.
Working knowledge of the investment operations lifecycle: portfolio construction, order and execution flow, holdings, corporate actions, benchmarks, NAV, and reconciliation.
Ownership of a platform build for expert users, including the adoption effort and the judgment about what to simplify.
A commercial instinct: you have made a business case, quantified its return, and been held to it.
Bachelor’s degree required; advanced degree or certification (CFA, MBA) a plus.

Nice To Have

ETF-specific experience: creation and redemption, basket construction, primary market workflow, and index tracking.
1940-Act fund and SEC-registered adviser context; recordkeeping (Rule 204-2), Regulation S-P, and 15(c) board reporting.
Institutional investment platforms as a buyer, implementer, or product owner; or technology as part of a firm’s client-facing narrative.

Compensation Range

$190,000-$210,000 plus annual bonus

Global X does not accept unsolicited resumes or candidate profiles from recruitment agencies, search firms, or third-party recruiters.

Compensation & Benefits

Global X offers a competitive total compensation package, including base salary, annual performance bonus, and a comprehensive benefits program:

Competitive base salary with annual performance-based bonus
Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance
401(k) retirement plan with company matching
Generous paid time off and company holidays
Professional development and continuing education opportunities
Hybrid work flexibility
Life and disability insurance
Wellness programs and employee assistance program (EAP)

About Global X

Global X was founded in 2008. For more than fifteen years, our mission has been empowering investors with unexplored and intelligent solutions. Our product lineup features a wide range of ETF strategies and more than $94 billion in assets under management as of June 30, 2026. While we are distinguished for our thematic, income, and international ETFs, we also offer core and other funds to suit a wide range of investment objectives. Explore our ETFs, research and insights, and more at www.globalxetfs.com.

Global X is a member of Mirae Asset Financial Group (Mirae Asset), a global leader in financial services, with $1 trillion in assets under management worldwide as of May 31, 2026. Mirae Asset has an extensive global ETF platform ranging across the U.S., Australia, Brazil, Canada, Colombia, Europe, Hong Kong, India, Japan, Korea,

jobs.title: Financial Services - Technology Consulting - Product Manager - Senior
jobs.description:
Location: Anywhere in Country

At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.

We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go. Join EY and help to build a better working world.

EY is a leader in serving the global financial services marketplace and the only professional services firm with a separate business unit dedicated to the financial services industry – the Financial Services Organization (FSO). Our focused model and bold ambition have put us at the center of the events that continue to reshape and redefine our industry, working side by side with a range of clients from our most venerable institutions to dynamic new entrants across Banking and Capital Markets, Wealth and Asset Management, Insurance, and Real Estate, Hospitality and Construction. Our purpose is to help build a financial services industry in which financial institutions are trusted and flourish, and the global economy is healthy, growing and secure. If you have a passion for rallying together to solve complex challenges, then come join our dynamic FSO team!

The opportunity

The Product and Experience Design (PxD) Team, part of the Platforms competency within FSO Technology Consulting, works collaboratively with clients to transform their businesses through disruptive innovation and human-centered design. The team helps clients modernize systems, processes, operating structures and products, while applying AI-enabled methods to improve how opportunities are identified, concepts are tested, requirements are developed and product decisions are made. We support the development of high-performing business and customer-facing platforms and services in a rapidly changing and competitive environment. Our team helps clients sustain competitive advantage and profitability by defining technology and product strategies, designing AI-enabled solutions and supporting the execution of complex transformations.

We are looking for an experienced, passionate and results-oriented Product Manager who combines strong product-management fundamentals with practical experience using AI-enabled tools and methods to support product discovery and delivery. The successful candidate will be an effective problem solver who can identify appropriate opportunities to apply AI, use these capabilities responsibly and validate AI-generated outputs with business, design and technology stakeholders.

Your Key Responsibilities

The goal is to support our clients in transforming their businesses through product management. As a Product Manager, you will work with multidisciplinary feature teams, including user experience experts, architects, engineers, data and AI specialists and others, to define and launch products and services for large global organizations. You will use user-centered, data-driven and AI-enabled methods to synthesize research, identify unmet needs, develop and test concepts, define business requirements and support product decisions. You will advocate for users throughout the product lifecycle and apply human judgment to validate AI-generated insights and outputs. You can simplify complex processes and touchpoints, prioritize opportunities, contribute to product roadmaps, manage product backlogs and coordinate teams to release quality products within planned timelines. You understand modern platform structures, cloud architectures, digital platforms and enablers, data strategy considerations, and the opportunities and limitations of AI-enabled products. In addition, you understand how product and delivery organizations operate within complex, regulated national and global companies. Outside client engagements, you have experience supporting business development activities, such as pursuits and proposals, and practice-building activities such as mentoring colleagues and developing or delivering training.

Skills And Attributes For

Strategy and Organization
Support the development of product strategies that align with business objectives, identify appropriate opportunities for AI-enabled capabilities, and account for technology, data, experience design, risk and adoption considerations
Support the definition of product organization and operating models, including product taxonomy, organizational structure, funding methods, product delivery processes, governance models and decision rights, while considering the roles, skills, controls and human oversight needed for AI-enabled product development
Improve portfolio management with product metrics and OKRs that align work to business objectives and increase transparency/traceability of outcomes

Technology Delivery
Support technology delivery by using traditional and AI-enabled research and requirements tools to translate product vision, customer insights, business rules and enterprise knowledge into traceable business requirements, user stories and acceptance criteria; validate generated outputs with subject-matter experts; and help prioritize backlogs and maintain roadmaps
Support cross-functional teams of designers, engineers, data and AI specialists and testers through the software development lifecycle, using rapid prototypes and AI-assisted tools to test concepts, workflows and value hypotheses before implementation and deployment
Advocate for and help operationalize cross-functional practices such as user testing, experimentation, functional and regression test automation, evaluation of AI-enabled features, and alignment with industry, client, risk and regulatory standards

Product Enablement
Use traditional and AI-enabled product management tools, such as JIRA, Azure DevOps, Aha!, Productboard, requirements repositories, AI assistants, enterprise knowledge tools and prototype-driven development platforms, to support discovery, prioritize opportunities, develop requirements, test concepts and deliver technology solutions
Use product analytics software and frameworks, such as Pendo and Amplitude, together with AI-enabled analysis, to synthesize user feedback, research, behavioral data and product performance; identify patterns and unmet needs; and translate findings into testable hypotheses and actionable recommendations
Advise on and implement best practices and standards for experience design, agile delivery, technology, data and responsible AI, adapting methods to client needs and established governance
Apply AI-enabled methods across selected parts of the product lifecycle—including research synthesis, concept generation, rapid prototyping, requirements development, backlog refinement and product analytics—to improve speed and quality. Use approved tools and reusable prompts, validate outputs and follow established safeguards for responsible use

Core Consulting
Construct and communicate a compelling story to rally the client around potential changes and associated benefits
Drive desired outcomes defined in client engagements and carry through to implementation
Begin developing long-term client relationships and networks and cultivate business development opportunities.
Effectively work with client engagement teams with diverse skills and backgrounds fostering an innovative and inclusive work environment.
Demonstrate an understanding of the current technology and AI environment, relevant financial services trends and the evolving product management toolchain, and apply that understanding to engagement delivery and client service issues

To qualify for the role you must have

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems Management, or a related field and 3 years of progressive, post-baccalaureate work experience. Alternatively, will accept a Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems Management, or a related field and 2 years of work experience.
Experience using AI-enabled tools or methods to support one or more product activities—such as research synthesis, opportunity assessment, requirements development, rapid prototyping or product analytics—with appropriate human review of generated outputs
Proven delivery skills including the ability to identify issues and risks and escalate appropriately, manage communications with EY and client team members, and be accountable for client deliverables
Facilitate discussions with technical, design and business subject-matter resources to document requirements, establish a vision, and articulate alternatives for future state solutions across various domains and channels.
Has supported product vision, defined and managed product roadmaps, prioritized and managed backlogs, and supported product or technology launches. Experience should include contributing to the identification of suitable AI-enabled opportunities, testing value or feasibility through prototypes or experiments, and defining measurable outcomes for AI-enabled features
Can participate in and drive ideation sessions, standups, sprints and scrums.
Has specific domain knowledge and understands the market, customer, technology, data, AI and regulatory dynamics affecting the product, including the opportunities, limitations and risks of applying AI in a complex financial services environment
Experience with successfully managing projects with defined deliverables and budgets. Experience must include budgeting and managing the schedule; client relationship management; communicating strategically around key issues; conflict resolution and consensus building.
Must have a thorough understanding of complex information systems and technology organizations and to be able to work effectively between the application, data infrastructure, operations and security architectural spaces
Proven delivery skills including the ability to scope/size a project; staff a team with the appropriate skill set; provide subject matter direction and guidance to a team; manage communications with the project sponsors and manage the delivery of an engagement workstream.
Outstanding written and verbal communication skills
Requires domestic and regional travel up to 80% to serve client needs.

Ideally, you’ll also have

Experience working alongside data, analytics or AI specialists to shape use cases, define outcomes and test AI-enabled features
Familiarity with product analytics, experimentation and evaluation methods, including approaches for validating the quality and usefulness of AI-generated outputs
Relevant product management, agile, design, cloud, data or AI training or certifications

What We Look For

We’re interested in self-motivated individuals who can easily function in a high demand, performance-driven environment. In addition we’re looking for people who recognize the accomplishments of the team before the individual and are sought after as people developers. If you’re passionate about problem-solving and helping our clients with some of their most complex issues, this role is for you.

What Working At EY Offers

We offer a competitive compensation package where you’ll be rewarded based on your performance and recognized for the value you bring to our business. In addition, our Total Rewards package includes medical and dental coverage, both pension and 401(k) plans, a minimum of 15 days of vacation plus ten observed holidays and three paid personal days, and a range of programs and benefits designed to support your physical, financial and social well-being. Plus, we offer:

Excellent training and development opportunities through established programs and on-the-job training
Feedback on your performance that will accelerate your growth

About EY

As a global leader in assurance, tax, transaction and consulting services, we hire and develop the most passionate people in their field to help build a better working world. This starts with a culture that believes in giving you the training, opportunities and creative freedom to make things better. So that whenever you join, however long you stay, the exceptional EY experience lasts a lifetime.

jobs.title: Head of Business Technology Engineering
jobs.description:
About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About The Role

Anthropic's Business Technology Engineering team builds the systems the company runs on. We own the internal platforms every employee uses and our collaboration tooling, and we embed engineers directly with Legal, Security, Communications, Product Operations and other business functions to rebuild how their work gets done with Claude at the center. Our mandate is to make Anthropic the best-run company in the world at using its own models internally, and to be the example our customers point to.

We are hiring an engineering leader to run this org. You will lead a growing engineering organization across two tracks: Platforms
, which builds and operates the shared systems the company depends on, and Forward Deployed
, which drops into a business function, proves Claude wins on a real workflow, hands off, and moves on. You will partner on defining the roadmap, build relationships with functional leaders, grow the team, and shape what forward deployed engineering looks like inside a frontier AI lab.

You'll report to the Head of Business Technology and IT, within the Security organization, and you’ll make up the full Business Technology function along with a team of Business Systems Analysts and Product Managers. Together, BizTech partners closely with IT Engineering on corporate systems and endpoints; with Security Engineering on data handling and permissions for agentic workflows; with Labs and Product on dogfooding and the internal builds that become external patterns; with GTM, who point Enterprise customers at this team as the reference for how Anthropic runs internally; and with the leaders of Legal, Workplace, Communications, Product Operations and Product Support, who are your customers.

Responsibilities

Lead and scale a global org of engineers; hire, level and develop the leads under you.
Partner, develop, and execute a year-plus roadmap for how Anthropic's business functions work with Claude, and the success metrics that go with it.

Role Summary

Global X operates a large and growing ETF platform across multiple markets. Our investment desk runs on proprietary technology built in-house for portfolio management, trading, and the operational workflow around it. We are hiring the founding product owner for that platform — in effect, the operating system for our trading and portfolio management desks — measured on adoption and business impact rather than delivery milestones.

The mandate is to make expert work easier and give the business more capacity: guided workflows where a process is multi-step, expert surfaces where they genuinely help. Deciding where that line falls is the substance of the role — in a regulated domain where accuracy is a compliance matter and your users will tell you immediately when something is wrong.

This is a product role for someone who builds. A clickable prototype is the preferred form of a specification. We are an AI-forward team, and product is expected to move at the same speed as engineering. You will help shape the product function as the platform and the team grow around it.

Key Responsibilities

Product Strategy & Workflow Definition

Define and execute the product strategy and roadmap, sequenced by business value and defensible to stakeholders who each want their own priority first.
Decide what becomes a guided flow and what stays an expert surface, and own the defaults — grounded in observed usage, not the loudest request.
Design workflows that hold up across markets, calendars, and regions rather than encoding the practice of a single desk.
Track ETF market structure developments and regulatory change, and translate their implications into product direction.

Prototyping & Hands-On Delivery

Prototype your own proposals with AI product tooling and put something clickable in front of a portfolio manager rather than describing it.
Do your own analysis. Query the data, quantify the case, and bring evidence rather than anecdote.
Write requirements and acceptance criteria an engineer can build from directly, and run delivery against a visible, prioritized backlog.

Commercial Impact & Platform Growth

Own the business case. Quantify where the platform creates capacity, reduces risk, and shortens time to launch, and make that case to leadership.
Drive expansion beyond the initial desk: identify the next adopters across teams and affiliated businesses, and build the plan to bring them on.

Adoption, Risk & Governance

Own adoption: readiness criteria, sequencing, champions, training, and the communications that carry each stage of rollout.
Define how AI-assisted and agent-initiated actions behave in the product — what a user sees, what requires approval, and what is recorded.
Partner with compliance and risk so controls, approval thresholds, and audit evidence are designed in, and assess risk with regard for the firm’s reputation and obligations.

You Are

Energized by building alongside engineers, and happiest when something is in front of a user.
A self-starter who does well with ambiguity and a wide remit.
Curious beyond your comfort zone, and quick to learn a domain in depth.
Willing to challenge convention, and disciplined about bringing evidence when you do.
Precise. You would rather be right than fast, and you know when the two are not in conflict.

Qualifications

7+ years in product management, product ownership, or senior business analysis for investment or trading technology, buy side or platform vendor.
Hands-on output: prototypes, demos, internal tools, or analyses you built yourself and would enjoy showing us, and fluent daily use of AI tooling to produce them.
Working knowledge of the investment operations lifecycle: portfolio construction, order and execution flow, holdings, corporate actions, benchmarks, NAV, and reconciliation.
Ownership of a platform build for expert users, including the adoption effort and the judgment about what to simplify.
A commercial instinct: you have made a business case, quantified its return, and been held to it.
Bachelor’s degree required; advanced degree or certification (CFA, MBA) a plus.

Nice To Have

ETF-specific experience: creation and redemption, basket construction, primary market workflow, and index tracking.
1940-Act fund and SEC-registered adviser context; recordkeeping (Rule 204-2), Regulation S-P, and 15(c) board reporting.
Institutional investment platforms as a buyer, implementer, or product owner; or technology as part of a firm’s client-facing narrative.

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About The Role

Anthropic's Business Technology Engineering team builds the systems the company runs on. We own the internal platforms every employee uses and our collaboration tooling, and we embed engineers directly with Legal, Security, Communications, Product Operations and other business functions to rebuild how their work gets done with Claude at the center. Our mandate is to make Anthropic the best-run company in the world at using its own models internally, and to be the example our customers point to.

We are hiring an engineering leader to run this org. You will lead a growing engineering organization across two tracks: Platforms
, which builds and operates the shared systems the company depends on, and Forward Deployed
, which drops into a business function, proves Claude wins on a real workflow, hands off, and moves on. You will partner on defining the roadmap, build relationships with functional leaders, grow the team, and shape what forward deployed engineering looks like inside a frontier AI lab.

You'll report to the Head of Business Technology and IT, within the Security organization, and you’ll make up the full Business Technology function along with a team of Business Systems Analysts and Product Managers. Together, BizTech partners closely with IT Engineering on corporate systems and endpoints; with Security Engineering on data handling and permissions for agentic workflows; with Labs and Product on dogfooding and the internal builds that become external patterns; with GTM, who point Enterprise customers at this team as the reference for how Anthropic runs internally; and with the leaders of Legal, Workplace, Communications, Product Operations and Product Support, who are your customers.

Responsibilities

Lead and scale a global org of engineers; hire, level and develop the leads under you.
Partner, develop, and execute a year-plus roadmap for how Anthropic's business functions work with Claude, and the success metrics that go with it.
Run the Platforms track: reliability, velocity and scale of Claude Support and the platform layer that every employee depends on.
Run the Forward Deployed track: engagement portfolio, prioritization across functions, handoffs to durable owners, and adoption that actually moves.
Be the technical executive partner to the leaders of Legal, Workplace, Comms, Product Ops and Product Support; make the case for ambitious deployment and for the boundaries on it in the same conversation.
Partner with Labs and Product on dogfooding: feed load-bearing signal back ("here is the eval that shows the gap") and ship internal builds that become external product patterns.
Represent how Anthropic runs internally to Enterprise customers alongside GTM.
Set the engineering bar: production-adjacent builds, eval rigor, reusable patterns, responsible internal deployment with real data and real permissions.

You may be a good fit if you

Have 12+ years in software engineering and 6+ years leading engineers, including at least 3 years managing managers and at least one org of 20+ across multiple domains that you structured yourself
Have run internal-tools, business-systems or platform engineering at a company that added functions faster than it added engineers, and can speak to reliability outcomes on the platform side and adoption outcomes on the embedded side
Lead through technical judgment: whether or not you've been hands-on lately, you can go from an agent architecture to its eval design to its failure modes with your engineers, and your reviews make their builds better
Can walk a General Counsel, a Head of Workplace or a room of senior engineers with strong opinions through a trade-off, make a recommendation, and bring them to a decision they'll commit to
Can hold a high bar on craft while saying no to low-leverage work, and explain the no to the person who asked.
Want real ownership of how a frontier AI lab runs itself on its own models, and care about doing that responsibly — real data, real permissions, real people on the other end

Strong candidates may also have

Forward deployed, software engineering or applied AI leadership experience with external customers.
Product management experience or a track record partnering closely with PMs and analysts.
Experience with corporate systems (Salesforce, Workday, Google Workspace, Slack) at platform scale.
Have built the career rubric or leveling framework for a new kind of engineering role, or stood up a forward deployed function from zero

$405,000—$485,000 USD

Logistics

Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience

Required field of study:
A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience

Minimum years of experience:
Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position

Location-based hybrid policy:
Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices.

Visa sponsorship:
We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.

We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification.
Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.

Your safety matters to us.
To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings.

We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.

The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.

Develop and share POVs on the work we’re doing at Stellar, and be willing to disagree and commit if necessary

At least 5 years of people management experience, including managing a multi-person Product Management team — hiring, coaching, and performance management, not just individual PM execution.
Experience running a roadmap or capacity governance process across more than one team.
Comfortable holding PMs accountable to a plan without owning the deep domain expertise of every squad they run.

Healthcare or health-tech background a plus, particularly value-based care — several squads’ work is EHR-integration- and VBC-specific.

At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.

We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go. Join EY and help to build a better working world.

EY is a leader in serving the global financial services marketplace and the only professional services firm with a separate business unit dedicated to the financial services industry – the Financial Services Organization (FSO). Our focused model and bold ambition have put us at the center of the events that continue to reshape and redefine our industry, working side by side with a range of clients from our most venerable institutions to dynamic new entrants across Banking and Capital Markets, Wealth and Asset Management, Insurance, and Real Estate, Hospitality and Construction. Our purpose is to help build a financial services industry in which financial institutions are trusted and flourish, and the global economy is healthy, growing and secure. If you have a passion for rallying together to solve complex challenges, then come join our dynamic FSO team!

The opportunity

The Product and Experience Design (PxD) Team, part of the Platforms competency within FSO Technology Consulting, works collaboratively with clients to transform their businesses through disruptive innovation and human-centered design. The team helps clients modernize systems, processes, operating structures and products, while applying AI-enabled methods to improve how opportunities are identified, concepts are tested, requirements are developed and product decisions are made. We support the development of high-performing business and customer-facing platforms and services in a rapidly changing and competitive environment. Our team helps clients sustain competitive advantage and profitability by defining technology and product strategies, designing AI-enabled solutions and supporting the execution of complex transformations.

We are looking for an experienced, passionate and results-oriented Product Manager who combines strong product-management fundamentals with practical experience using AI-enabled tools and methods to support product discovery and delivery. The successful candidate will be an effective problem solver who can identify appropriate opportunities to apply AI, use these capabilities responsibly and validate AI-generated outputs with business, design and technology stakeholders.

Your Key Responsibilities

The goal is to support our clients in transforming their businesses through product management. As a Product Manager, you will work with multidisciplinary feature teams, including user experience experts, architects, engineers, data and AI specialists and others, to define and launch products and services for large global organizations. You will use user-centered, data-driven and AI-enabled methods to synthesize research, identify unmet needs, develop and test concepts, define business requirements and support product decisions. You will advocate for users throughout the product lifecycle and apply human judgment to validate AI-generated insights and outputs. You can simplify complex processes and touchpoints, prioritize opportunities, contribute to product roadmaps, manage product backlogs and coordinate teams to release quality products within planned timelines. You understand modern platform structures, cloud architectures, digital platforms and enablers, data strategy considerations, and the opportunities and limitations of AI-enabled products. In addition, you understand how product and delivery organizations operate within complex, regulated national and global companies. Outside client engagements, you have experience supporting business development activities, such as pursuits and proposals, and practice-building activities such as mentoring colleagues and developing or delivering training.

Support the definition of product organization and operating models, including product taxonomy, organizational structure, funding methods, product delivery processes, governance models and decision rights, while considering the roles, skills, controls and human oversight needed for AI-enabled product development
Improve portfolio management with product metrics and OKRs that align work to business objectives and increase transparency/traceability of outcomes

Technology Delivery

Support cross-functional teams of designers, engineers, data and AI specialists and testers through the software development lifecycle, using rapid prototypes and AI-assisted tools to test concepts, workflows and value hypotheses before implementation and deployment
Advocate for and help operationalize cross-functional practices such as user testing, experimentation, functional and regression test automation, evaluation of AI-enabled features, and alignment with industry, client, risk and regulatory standards

Product Enablement
Use traditional and AI-enabled product management tools, such as JIRA, Azure DevOps, Aha!, Productboard, requirements repositories, AI assistants, enterprise knowledge tools and prototype-driven development platforms, to support discovery, prioritize opportunities, develop requirements, test concepts and deliver technology solutions
Use product analytics software and frameworks, such as Pendo and Amplitude, together with AI-enabled analysis, to synthesize user feedback, research, behavioral data and product performance; identify patterns and unmet needs; and translate findings into testable hypotheses and actionable recommendations
Advise on and implement best practices and standards for experience design, agile delivery, technology, data and responsible AI, adapting methods to client needs and established governance
Apply AI-enabled methods across selected parts of the product lifecycle—including research synthesis, concept generation, rapid prototyping, requirements development, backlog refinement and product analytics—to improve speed and quality. Use approved tools and reusable prompts, validate outputs and follow established safeguards for responsible use

Construct and communicate a compelling story to rally the client around potential changes and associated benefits
Drive desired outcomes defined in client engagements and carry through to implementation
Begin developing long-term client relationships and networks and cultivate business development opportunities.
Effectively work with client engagement teams with diverse skills and backgrounds fostering an innovative and inclusive work environment.
Demonstrate an understanding of the current technology and AI environment, relevant financial services trends and the evolving product management toolchain, and apply that understanding to engagement delivery and client service issues

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems Management, or a related field and 3 years of progressive, post-baccalaureate work experience. Alternatively, will accept a Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems Management, or a related field and 2 years of work experience.

Proven delivery skills including the ability to identify issues and risks and escalate appropriately, manage communications with EY and client team members, and be accountable for client deliverables
Facilitate discussions with technical, design and business subject-matter resources to document requirements, establish a vision, and articulate alternatives for future state solutions across various domains and channels.
Has supported product vision, defined and managed product roadmaps, prioritized and managed backlogs, and supported product or technology launches. Experience should include contributing to the identification of suitable AI-enabled opportunities, testing value or feasibility through prototypes or experiments, and defining measurable outcomes for AI-enabled features
Can participate in and drive ideation sessions, standups, sprints and scrums.

Experience with successfully managing projects with defined deliverables and budgets. Experience must include budgeting and managing the schedule; client relationship management; communicating strategically around key issues; conflict resolution and consensus building.
